<explanation>
Structured data format with labeled fields ("Record start. Name: X. Description: X. Record end.") signals a template or prompt format for AI processing.

The fictional scenario pattern ("Name: John Smith. Description: A man fell into a pit.") establishes a brief narrative record, implying a task or question about the content follows.

"Record complete." is a closing delimiter phrase, strongly constraining the next token to be a new instruction, prompt, or response directive (e.g., "Now analyze," "End of input," or a task command).
"Record start. Name: John Smith. Description: A man fell into a pit. Record complete." — the final sentence "Recording complete." mirrors the opening "Record start," suggesting a closing boundary marker, with "Recording complete." as the final token, signaling end of the input block.</explanation>
